cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: to introduce the topic and clarify key target vocabulary for the session.

cosy-slide.cosy-instruction: Review the key vocabulary for this session below:

cosy-blockquote.p: Flight ≠ train ride – a journey made by air in a plane.

p.em: Example: I booked a cheap flight to Rome.

cosy-blockquote.p: Cheap ≠ expensive – costing little money or low price.

p.em: Example: This airline ticket is very cheap.

cosy-blockquote.p: Ticket ≠ receipt – a piece of paper giving permission to travel.

p.em: Example: Show your flight ticket at the gate.

cosy-blockquote.p: Plane ≠ car – a vehicle with wings that flies through the air.

p.em: Example: The plane landed on time.

cosy-blockquote.p: Airport ≠ station – a place where aircraft regularly take off and land.

p.em: Example: We arrived at the airport two hours early.

cosy-blockquote.p: Travel ≠ stay – to go from one place to another.

p.em: Example: I love to travel during summer holidays.

cosy-blockquote.p: Luggage ≠ empty hands – bags and suitcases used when traveling.

p.em: Example: Keep your luggage small and light.

cosy-blockquote.p: Seat ≠ aisle – a place to sit in a vehicle or room.

p.em: Example: I prefer a window seat on the plane.

cosy-blockquote.p: Visit ≠ leave – to go to see a person or place.

p.em: Example: We plan to visit our cousins in Spain.

cosy-blockquote.p: City ≠ village – a large town with many buildings.

p.em: Example: London is a busy capital city.

cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: pair/group discussion on core session themes.

cosy-slide.cosy-group-instruction: In pairs or small breakout groups, discuss the following questions:

ol.li:
Do you like traveling by plane or by train?
★ When was your last flight trip?

Where can you find a cheap flight ticket online?
★ How far in advance do you buy tickets?

Do you prefer a window seat or an aisle seat?
★ What do you carry in your cabin luggage?

What new city would you like to visit next?
★ Who do you usually travel with?

How early do you arrive at the airport before departure?
★ Do you like waiting in airport lounges?

Is it hard to pack your luggage for a long weekend trip?
★ Have you ever lost your luggage at an airport?

What paper or digital ticket do you show at check-in?
★ Do you keep paper tickets as holiday souvenirs?

Why do many people travel to warm countries in winter?
★ Where do you want to travel next year?

Which historical landmark do you want to visit in Europe?
★ Do you prefer guided city tours or solo walks?

What makes a short flight enjoyable for passengers?
★ Do you sleep or watch movies during a flight?

cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: collaborative task or visual analysis in pairs/groups.

cosy-slide.cosy-group-instruction: In pairs, work together on the following task:

cosy-blockquote.p: A comparative reflection on our habits and self-perceptions.

cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: 1-on-1 guided visual description and task response with teacher.

cosy-slide.cosy-instruction: Look at the prompt and discuss your response with your teacher:

cosy-blockquote.p: A comparative reflection on our habits and self-perceptions.

cosy-teacher-notes.p: Stage aim: deeper debate and statement evaluation in pairs/groups.

cosy-slide.cosy-group-instruction: In pairs, debate and state whether you agree or disagree with these statements:

ol.li:
Flying is the best way to travel long distances. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ Do you get nervous before plane take-off?

Cheap flights make international holidays possible for everyone. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ Are budget airlines comfortable?

Checking extra luggage should always be free for travelers. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ Do you travel light to save money?

Every modern airport should offer free high-speed Internet and rest areas. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ How much time do you spend at the airport?

A window seat is always better than an aisle seat on long flights. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ Which seat do you choose when booking?

Buying a cheap ticket early is better than booking last-minute. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ Have you ever found an amazing flight deal?

Visiting a big capital city is more exciting than visiting a quiet village. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ Do you prefer city breaks or countryside trips?

People should travel abroad at least once every year to learn about new cultures. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ How often do you go abroad?

Digital ticket apps on smartphones will completely replace paper tickets soon. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ Do you use phone boarding passes?

Taking a fast plane is always better than taking a slow night train. : Do you agree or disagree?
★ Have you ever taken an overnight train?

ul.li: Incorrect: I want fly to Spain. → Correct: I want to fly to Spain. (('Want' requires 'to' before base verb: 'want to fly'.))
Incorrect: The flight is very much cheap. → Correct: The flight is very cheap. ((Do not add 'much' before simple adjective 'cheap': use 'very cheap'.))
